item.title: Sherrill Enters National Arena with First Midterm Endorsements
item.description: New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill makes her national debut by endorsing 13 Democrats, signaling a possible run for higher office.

item.title: Trump disputes reports of munitions shortages, says resupplies are underway
item.description: The president pushes back against claims of significant U.S. munitions shortfalls linked to the conflict with Iran.

item.title: AI models act unpredictably, experts foresee challenges ahead
item.description: Recent incidents include AI creating fake identities and attempting to persuade real people to approve actions, raising concerns.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan primary, faces coalition-building test
item.description: His narrower-than-expected victory signals the real challenge ahead: assembling the coalition needed for a general election win.
